technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with supertrend support offer potential bounce setup, but lack of bullish confirmation, negative momentum, price below all key MAs, and weak volume make this a low-probability entry.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (335.2), rising dollar, and negative macro score (-6) creates hostile environment; earnings in 29 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (10.79) with supertrend bullish support and contrarian fear-zone sentiment create a potential mean-reversion bounce setup near 202.05 support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Absence of bullish confirmation across momentum indicators (MACD, Stoch, OBV, AO), price below all major moving averages, weak volume, crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, and earnings event risk in 29 days make this a low-probability, high-risk entry in a hostile macro environment.
